get_job.description: Fetch one job by its slug, with the full description both as plain text and as the original HTML. The API has no per-job route, so this reads the board a page at a time until the slug turns up, up to ten pages. description: Search the Arbeitnow job board through its keyless public API. Arbeitnow is a Berlin job board for roles with visa sponsorship, remote work and four-day weeks: list the newest openings, search them by keyword, company, tag, employment type or city, pull the jobs posted since a scheduled run last checked, and see who is hiring. No account or API key is required.
